assertions.name: he4_occupancy_binding_matches_to_10pct
assertions.source: 4-row Hankel-normalized B_gate = -E0*ln(W_lambda / Z_12^{(4)}) - E_C = 27.1845 MeV reproduces 4He B_AME = 28.2957 MeV to 4.1% (c_lambda = 1.0409).

assertions.name: all_rows_have_strict_unit_interval_4row_plancherel_probability
assertions.source: 0 < P_lambda^{(4)}(q_0) = W_lambda / Z_{3A}^{(4)} < 1 and E_gate_strong > 0 for every isotope in group

description: 80-dps SU(4) 4-row Hankel-normalized q-Plancherel occupancy P_lambda^{(4)}(q_0) = W_lambda(q_0) / Z_{3A}^{(4)}(q_0) and parameter-free 3D alpha-simplex coordination binding probe (bean qou-br4t). Normalizing by Z_{3A}^{(4)}(q_0) guarantees 0 < P_lambda^{(4)}(q_0) < 1 and strictly positive strong surprisal for all A, reproducing 4He binding to 4.1% after Coulomb (1.2% strong-only) and, when combined with Pauli [1^4] alpha-clustering and 3D alpha-simplex coordination, restoring O(A) extensivity through 238U with zero fitted parameters and zero float64 intermediates.
